name: backless slab bench
caption: A backless slab bench with a thick single slab seat and two end supports. A seat slab rests on two curved supports; the backrest joins both ends. Curved seat edges stay continuous with an even slab thickness. Overall width is 2.60 times depth; height is 0.40 times width. Parts follow functional positions. Continuous oak brown, dark brown, tan color regions distinguish the body and attachments. The front reveals functional parts; side and top views reveal depth, connections and layout.
